run_process_scene: run process_scene to extract Matterport3D house data into region-based frame subsets
load_raw_data: load raw Matterport3D RGB, depth, pose, and intrinsic data filtered by camera UUIDs into organized output directories
process_pc: process Matterport3D point cloud files by combining points, colors, normals, segments, and labels into a single array
region_to_camera_mapping_fn: parse panorama_to_region.txt to build a mapping from room regions to their associated camera IDs
load_matrix_from_txt: load a 4x4 or 3x3 transformation matrix from a text file containing space-separated float values
